name: Trade Shortcuts
tagline: Bybit alerts and confirmations on G2
description: Build rules on your phone and review exact alerts and trade proposals on your G2. Confirm by touch, or use a spoken answer when voice is enabled. Supports simulated positions and Bybit Demo Trading or Testnet.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks to your own Trade Shortcuts server, which holds the exchange keys.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: With voice answers enabled, the G2 microphone listens after an alert, during the cancellation countdown, and when Speak is chosen on a position. Audio goes through your Trade Shortcuts server to OpenAI for transcription. A spoken close only raises a confirmation card.
